import json
d=json.load(open('.ai/task/repair-w57-20260930/CONTEXTUAL-ENVELOPE-f4a1.json'))
p=d['payload']
out=[]
for i,(e,b) in enumerate(zip(p['translation_snapshot'],p['bounded_context'])):
    if len(e['source'])<=1500: continue
    c=json.loads(b['context'])
    s=e['source'].split('\n'); t=e['target'].split('\n')
    hdr=f"=== [{i}] {c['section']} srcLF={len(s)} tgtLF={len(t)}"
    lines=[hdr]
    if len(s)==len(t):
        for a,bb in zip(s,t):
            if a.strip() or bb.strip(): lines.append("S: "+a); lines.append("T: "+bb)
    else:
        lines.append("MISMATCH"); lines+=["S: "+x for x in s]; lines+=["T: "+x for x in t]
    out.append("\n".join(lines))
open('/tmp/w57f4a1_long.txt','w').write("\n".join(out))
EOF

python3 - <<'EOF'
import json,re
d=json.load(open('.ai/task/repair-w57-20260930/CONTEXTUAL-ENVELOPE-f4a1.json'))
p=d['payload']
pat=re.compile(r'#\{[a-z]+\}#|#[A-Z_]+#|#[0-9A-F]{6}#|%[-0-9.]*[a-zA-Z%]|@[a-z]+@|<\?.*?\?>|\[/?[a-z]\]|\t|\$\{[^}]*\}')
from collections import Counter
for i,e in enumerate(p['translation_snapshot']):
    a=Counter(pat.findall(e['source'])); b=Counter(pat.findall(e['target']))
    if a!=b: print(i, dict(a-b), dict(b-a))
    # leading tabs per line
    sl=[len(x)-len(x.lstrip('\t')) for x in e['source'].split('\n')]
    tl=[len(x)-len(x.lstrip('\t')) for x in e['target'].split('\n')]
    if sl!=tl: print(i,'tabs',sl,tl)
    if e['source'].endswith('\n')!=e['target'].endswith('\n'): print(i,'trailing LF')
EOF
